strategy.observation: Linear supports delegating entire issues end-to-end to AI agents acting as teammates.
strategy.offer_link: Recruiting and scheduling customer interviews could help Linear's product team explore which issues customers would delegate to agents and what oversight they would need, providing input for decisions about agent workflows.
hypotheses: Linear's product team may be evaluating how customers adopt end-to-end issue delegation.
Customers may differ in which tasks they trust agents to complete and when they want human review.
Outside recruiting and scheduling support may help the team reach relevant interview participants with less coordination work.
strategy.angle: With Linear supporting end-to-end issue delegation to AI agents, would recruiting customers to interview about delegation boundaries and human oversight be useful to your product team?
strategy.fit_reason: The offer supports customer research around a specific product capability with concrete questions to investigate, making it relevant to a Head of Product; Linear's current research needs and willingness to outsource recruitment remain unconfirmed.

draft.subject: Interviews on agent delegation boundaries
draft.body:
If you're evaluating end-to-end issue delegation to AI agents, customer interviews could help clarify what people would hand off and where they'd want human review.

I recruit and schedule customer interview participants for product teams. That would let your team explore those boundaries without handling the participant coordination.

Would you prioritize interviewing customers already delegating entire issues, or those still deciding what they'd trust an agent to handle?
